in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the lineage or descent of Lord Shiva's worship.

in_hindi.name: रुध्वान्श
in_hindi.long_meaning: जो शिव की पूजा का वंश है

in_marathi.name: Rudhvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Waves of Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudhvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rudhvansh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Rudh’, meaning Shiva, and ‘Vansh’, meaning lineage or dynasty. It is believed that this name signifies the waves of blessings from Lord Shiva, bestowing strength, courage and victory upon the bearer.
